props.name: elements
props.description: Controlled optical elements. Positions are fractions of the bench, so they survive resizes.

props.name: defaultElements
props.description: Elements for uncontrolled use. Defaults to one equilateral prism.

props.name: onElementsChange
props.description: Called with the new elements whenever one is dragged, turned or nudged from the keyboard.

props.name: beam
props.description: Controlled beam: source position, direction, width and light.

props.name: onBeamChange
props.description: Called when the slider, a drag across the bench or the source’s handle changes the beam.

props.name: glass
props.description: Dense flint (n_d 1.767, Abbe 30), crown (n_d 1.517, Abbe 64 — about half the spread), or a fixed index with no dispersion at all. Flint is the default because it is what a dispersing prism is actually made of: crown is the reference glass, but its 1.4° fan is a few pixels of colour at the edges of a white beam, where flint’s 11° is a spectrum.

props.name: rays
props.description: Wavelengths sampled across 380–700 nm for white light, 3–64. More is a smoother spectrum and costs more.

props.name: fresnel
props.description: Split every ray at every face by the Fresnel equations, so the faint partial reflections appear.

props.name: interactive
props.description: Let the pointer and keyboard move and turn the elements and aim the beam.

props.name: sweep
props.description: Swing the beam ±5° back and forth, so the fan moves, until the first touch. Ignored under reduced motion.

props.name: paused
props.description: Hold the sweep, and any glide towards a new angle, where they are.

props.name: aspectRatio
props.description: Width over height of the bench.

props.name: controls
props.description: Show the beam-angle slider and the buttons under the bench.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the bench. An empty string makes the drawing decorative.
